answer_1.quote: Text style transfer is the task of converting a sentence from one style to another while preserving style-agnostic semantics.

answer_2.quote: performance is measured using three criteria: 1) style transfer accuracy, 2) content preservation, and 3) fluency.

answer_4.quote: To analyze the experimental results qualitatively, we also conduct human evaluation on GYAFC EM and Amazon datasets.
answer_4.guideline: evaluate three criteria: fluency, style control, and content preservation
